# ATEM ISO to FCPXML

> Free, MIT-licensed Mac app (and one-file Python converter) that turns a native Blackmagic ATEM ISO recording into a Final Cut Pro multicam project with the live switch and WAV audio.

A short navigation aid, not a crawler policy. The linked documentation is authoritative for current behavior.

The native SwiftUI app requires macOS 15 or later and includes a Swift conversion engine. The Python 3.9+ command-line tool remains the reference implementation. The soundtrack defaults to a selected WAV when available. ATEM live mix is an optional recorded mixed soundtrack, preserving the audible result of AFV and mixer changes without reconstructing mixer automation. The CLI selects it with --live-mix, mutually exclusive with --audio. Extra angles do not automatically play. GUI audio extras are opt-in; the CLI includes unpaired WAVs by default unless --no-extra-audio is supplied. Updates are manual through GitHub Releases.

## Start Here

- [Website](https://jeffalldridge.github.io/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/): workflow, installation, and compatibility.
- [README](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/blob/main/README.md): command-line options and limitations.
- [Download for Mac](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/releases/latest/download/ATEM-ISO-to-FCPXML.dmg): the signed, notarized disk image for macOS 15 or later. The [release page](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/releases/latest) also carries the Python converter and an optional Finder Quick Action.
- [Source](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml): Swift app and engine in Sources/, the Python reference converter atem_iso_to_fcpxml.py; the two are tested to produce identical XML.

## Implementation and Evidence

- [Vendor reference](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/blob/main/docs/vendor-reference.md): Blackmagic and Apple documentation, implementation implications, and evidence boundaries.
- [DRP observations](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/blob/main/docs/drp-format.md): observed native switcher log, not a general Resolve project archive parser.
- [FCPXML structure](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/blob/main/docs/fcpxml-structure.md): compound camera angles and verified import shapes.
- [Validation](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/blob/main/docs/validation.md): distinguish synthetic coverage, DTD checks, and real Final Cut round trips.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests, and what needs a Final Cut round trip. [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jeffalldridge/atem-iso-to-fcpxml/blob/main/AGENTS.md) holds the same rules for coding assistants.

## Important Limits

Tested with ATEM Mini Pro ISO recordings at 1080p60 in Final Cut Pro 12.4. Other models and frame rates are untested on real media. Matching WAVs replace camera audio when available; a camera without a WAV falls back to its MP4 audio. A .drp that holds several recording sessions is not opened by the app; the command-line version can choose one with --session. Start-time mismatches are warned about, not corrected. Keys use program footage when available, otherwise the first camera stands in with a marker. XML import specifies a named event rather than targeting the selected event. Matching event and clip names may prompt Keep Both / Replace; Keep Both preserves existing edits and may add numbered copies in that event. Camera and Media Player compounds share resources with their multicam angles, and selected source files, including still images, are visible in the browser. Generated compound names use plain hyphens. No transcoding, network calls, or AI at runtime. Never publish personal recordings, logs, or generated XML in bug reports.
